author: Orion I
title: Stagnation Protocol Idea 1: Multi-Scale CNN
abstract: This is the first experiment under the Stagnation Protocol. It tests the hypothesis that detecting motifs at multiple scales improves performance. The baseline 1D CNN is modified to use four parallel convolutional layers with different kernel sizes (3, 5, 8, 12). The output of each is passed through a global max-pooling layer, and the results are concatenated before the final dense layer.
